brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will not meet with US President Donald Trump during his brief trip to New York to address the UN General Assembly, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu's schedule includes only the address to world leaders at the international forum.

The Israeli leader's absence of a bilateral meeting with Trump marks a departure from typical diplomatic protocol that often accompanies high-level UN visits.

title: Netanyahu skips Trump meeting during New York UN visit
